name: Unchained Monk Totem Monk
body:
Totem monks spend a solitary year in a remote, wilderness locale where they form a permanent, unbreakable bond with a totem animal spirit. Once bonded to the animal spirit, the monk displays the physical characteristics and various qualities of their totem.

The following are class features of a totem monk.

Untamed (Ex)

Totem monks do not have to be lawful but they are prohibited from having an evil alignment. Any totem monk whose alignment becomes evil loses all benefits granted by their totem until they no longer have an evil component to their alignment. Additionally, the totem monk adds Knowledge (Nature) and Survival to their list of class skills, and they gain 2 extra skill points per level which must be applied to these skills.

This alters alignment and class skills.

Nature’s Vessel (Sp)

At 1st level, a totem monk learns four druid cantrips of their choice and can cast them at will as spell-like abilities.

This replaces the 1st level bonus feat.

Spirit Totem (Su)

At 2nd level, a totem monk forges a permanent bond with a formless entity, called a spirit totem, that merges with the totem monk. The spirit totem occupies the same space as the monk, is invisible, and is completely indistinguishable from the monk. It can’t be killed or affected as a separate entity. The only evidence of a totem monk’s bond to their spirit totem is a mark on their skin akin to a birthmark that vaguely resembles their totem animal spirit.

When a totem monk dies, the spirit totem returns to the Astral Plane, and the totem monk loses all benefits conferred by their spirit totem until they merge with a new one. A raised or reincarnated totem monk can merge with a new spirit totem 24 hours after returning to life. The new totem must come from the same totem category as the original, though it can be a different creature. For example, if a totem monk originally had the prowler totem with a cougar spirit, they must select the prowler totem again but could choose a tiger instead.

A spirit totem alerts a totem monk to the presence of danger and helps the totem monk to survive in the wilderness. The totem monk gains a +1 insight bonus on Perception checks and an insight bonus on Initiative rolls equal to their Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

Listed below are the spirit totems a totem monk can merge with. In addition to choosing the broad spirit totem category, the totem monk must indicate what specific creature their totem is. (If there is a question as to which category a player’s chosen creature belongs to, the GM has final jurisdiction.)

This replaces the 2nd level bonus feat.

Table: Spirit Totems
Spirit Totem	Examples
Fleetfoot	All hoofed animals and flightless birds (horses, zebras, donkeys, mules, pigs, boars, cows, giraffes, camels, antelopes, sheep, deer, hippos, goats, emus, ostriches, etc.
Howler	Canines (dogs, foxes, hyenas, wolves
Mimic	Primates (apes, lemurs, monkeys, simians, tarsiers, gorillas, baboons, chimpanzees
Padfoot	Mammals that don’t fit in any other category listed (rats, mice, squirrels, porcupines, rabbits, moles, raccoons, kangaroos, wombats, opossums, etc.
Prowler	Felines (house cats, cheetahs, cougars, tigers, lions, jaguars, lynxes, panthers, etc.
Powerhouse	Bears and elephants (elephants, grizzlies, black bears, polar bears, etc.
Scaled Survivor	Reptiles (alligators, crocodiles, lizards, snakes, turtles, tortoises
Wave-rider	Water-living mammals, fish, crustaceans, cephalopods, and flightless web-footed birds (whales, porpoises, dolphins, beavers, salmon, haddock, sharks, crabs, lobsters, octopuses, squid, penguins etc.
Webfoot	Amphibians (frogs, toads, newts, salamanders
Wind-rider	Bats and birds that can fly (owls, eagles, ravens, flamingos, bats, cardinals, robins, hummingbirds, etc.
Trappings (Ex)

At 4th level, a totem monk’s skin changes based upon the influence of their spirit totem. This change grants the totem monk an enhancement bonus to their existing natural armor class (similar to barkskin) rather than the untyped bonus to AC that a standard unchained monk receives. This enhancement bonus is only applied to the totem monk’s natural AC, not their CMD. Examples of the physical change might be a layer of feathers if their spirit totem is a bird, scales if their spirit totem is a fish or reptile, a thick pelt of fur if their spirit totem is a bear, or especially thick hide if their spirit totem is a hippopotamus.

This enhancement bonus to the totem monk’s natural armor class is +1 at 4th level. The bonus increases by 1 for every four totem monk levels thereafter (up to a maximum of +5 at 20th level). This enhancement bonus stacks with the totem monk’s natural armor bonus, but not with other enhancement bonuses to natural armor; if a totem monk gains an enhancement to their natural armor bonus from another source (like barkskin), they use the better of the two bonuses instead.

This alters the monk’s AC bonus.

Bonus Feat

At 6th level, and every level an unchained monk gains a bonus feat thereafter, the totem monk chooses their bonus feats according to their spirit totem. A totem monk doesn’t need to meet the prerequisites for these feats. Every totem has access to Alertness, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor (can only take once), Keen Scent, and Skill Focus (Perception). The table below lists the additional feat options available for each totem.

This alters bonus feats.

Table: Spirit Totems
Spirit Totem	Bonus Feat
Fleetfoot	Fleet, Ride-By Attack, Run
Howler	Improved Trip, Lightning Reflexes, Step Up
Mimic	Sure Grasp, Throw Anything, Tree Leaper
Padfoot	Agile Maneuvers, Dodge, Weapon Finesse
Powerhouse	Endurance, Iron Will, Toughness
Prowler	Cat’s Fall, Skill Focus (Acrobatics), Skill Focus (Stealth)
Scaled Survivor

Improved Lightning Reflexes, Intimidating Prowess, Ironhide

Wave-rider

Defensive Combat Training, Deep Diver, Skill Focus (Swim) Webfoot Athletic, Diehard, Swamper Wind-rider Deflect Arrows, Eagle-Eyed, Mobility

Nature Whisperer (Sp)

At 13th level, a totem monk can cast speak with animals as a spell-like ability a number of times per day equal to their Wisdom modifier (minimum once), and they can cast speak with plants and stone tell as spell-like abilities once each per day.

This replaces tongue of the sun and moon.

Totemic Aspect (Ex)

At 17th level, a totem monk takes on qualities of their spirit totem, gaining the benefits listed below for their totem.

This replaces timeless body.

Spirit Totem	Totemic Aspect
Fleetfoot	When you take the charge action, you do not incur a penalty to your Armor Class.
Howler	Whenever you confirm a critical hit against an opponent that is no more than one Size category larger than you, you can attempt to trip the target as a free action, but no more than once per round. For the purposes of this trip attempt only, you are treated as though you have the Improved Trip and Greater Trip feats.
Mimic	You gain a climb speed equal to your land speed (including your fast movement bonus) and you gain double the normal racial bonus to Climb checks for having a climb speed (+16 instead of +8).
Padfoot	Once per round, on the first attack of opportunity you would normally provoke due to your movement, you instead do not provoke the attack.
Powerhouse	You gain a +1 on damage rolls when you use your flurry of blows class feature.
Prowler	You are not penalized for making jumps without a running head start and your Dexterity score increases by +2.
Scaled Survivor

Whenever you confirm a critical hit against an opponent, you can make an Intimidate check (DC = 8 + target’s hit dice + target’s Wisdom modifier) as a free action, but no more than once per round. On a successful check, the target gains the cowering condition until the start of your next turn. On a failed check, the target is shaken until the start of your next turn instead. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Wave-rider and Webfoot

You gain resistance to cold 20, are always considered to be under the influence of freedom of movement while in water that is at least knee deep, and can hold your breath for a number of rounds equal to ten times your Constitution score (two times the Constitution score is normal).

Wind-rider (Su)

You are constantly under the effects of feather fall, and the insight bonus you gain to Perception checks from your spirit totem class feature increases to +5.

Into the Wilds: Ninjas and Monks, Copyright 2024, Bloodstone Press; author Beth Jones
